01 — About

About Me

I’m M. Hasnain, a developer and graphic designer who enjoys turning ideas into things people can actually use — whether that’s a web interface, a piece of software, or a visual identity.

My background spans front-end web development, systems-level programming, and design, which lets me think about a project from both the logic side and the look-and-feel side. I care about clean code, clear communication, and details that make an interface feel considered rather than default.

When I’m not building something, I’m usually learning a new tool, sketching a layout, or refining something I built last month.
